 for the petitioner.
 Mr. Sandeep Kumar, Dag, Punjab.
Harpreet Singh Brar J. (Oral)
1.

This petition has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., seeking anticipatory bail in case Fir
No.179 dated 25.10.2024, registered under Sections 420 Ipc (Sections 465, 467, 468, 471, 120-B Ipc
added lateron), at Police Station City Nawanshahr, District Sbs Nagar.
2. In compliance of the order dated 15.01.2025, the Investigating Officer is present in the Court.

3. On 04.12.2024, the following order was passed:-
"Xx Xx Xx Xx While placing reliance upon orders dated 22.11.2024 passed in Crm-M-58535-2024
(Annexure P-12), and 26.11.2024 passed in Crm-M-59081-2024 (Annexure P-
13), whereby the co-accused have been granted the relief of anticipatory bail by this Court, learned
counsel for the petitioner inter alia submits that the present petitioner is at 1 of 2 Neutral Citation
No:=2025:PHHC:018967 coequal pedestal.
Notice of motion.

1
Mr. Pardeep Bajaj, DAG, Punjab, accepts notice on behalf of respondent-State, and waives service.

At this stage, Mr. Naveen Batra, Advocate, has caused appearance on behalf of the complainant,
through a validly executed power of attorney in his favour.
The same is taken on record.
Adjourned to 15.01.2025.

Interim order in the same terms as in CRM-M- 58535-2024 and CRM-M-59081-2024, and to be heard alongwith them."
4.
Learned State counsel, on instructions from HC Ravi Kumar, at the very outset, informs the Court that the petitioner has joined the investigation and her custodial interrogation is not required.
5. In view of the statement of learned State counsel, order dated 04.12.2024 is hereby made absolute.
The petitioner shall abide by the terms and conditions envisaged under Section 482(2) of BNSS (erstwhile Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973).
6. The petition stands disposed of.
(HARPREET SINGH BRAR)
